The pure class interface. 
public abstract class CompoundFormat
  extends NestedFormat
This abstract class shall be inherited by all Format classes that are essentially built up out of other Formats. It also implements the default-behaviour of printing such a compound Format (which is just printing each of the components beneath the former ones).

Author:
Jacob Wieland (ughosage@cs.tu-berlin.de)
